problems.where: Section 1 point 6; C7; IMP-4 row; D-6; U2 Work (b) and exit 1
problems.claim: Gate 3 = 'two consecutive trivial, unchanged passes counted from the last pass that edited'; D-6: 'gate 3 costs nothing against main for code reviews'.
problems.finding: As worded, a review whose first pass leaves the tree unchanged has no edit to count from, so it needs two passes; main's rule, and R1's recommendation, stop it at pass 1. In the live run 5 of 7 implement reviews ended at pass 1, so a literal gate 3 adds a pass to each (contradicting 'zero added cost against main'). U2 exit 1 tests (edit,none,edit,none,none) and (edit,none,none) but never (none) -> P1 under gate 3. The stop branch retires the unchanged_first_pass key, so main's shortcut must be re-implemented inside gate 3.
problems.evidence: SP/eff2/decisions-release.json R1 recommendation: 'implement and carry-forward stop on a first pass that is unchanged (main's rule) and, after any edit, need two consecutive passes that are trivial AND measured-unchanged'; findings-improve.json IMP-4 and r5/dec-release.txt: 'adfd6e3b stays 5 passes, ed863ab3 stays 3, the other five end at P1'; changes/shiploop/improve-stop-rule-one-unchanged-pass.md ('the old unchanged_first_pass key is gone').
problems.correction: Define gate 3 as: stop on one trivial pass that leaves the tree unchanged when no pass has edited; after any edit, stop on two consecutive trivial unchanged passes. Add to U2 exit 1: a first pass that is unchanged stops at P1 under gate 3 (and gate 3 never stops a trivial-but-changed pass).

problems.where: 6.1 order row 1; 6.2 ('lines 3 and 4 on an inner stage, which has the delegation line first'); U8 exit 1; U7 invariants
problems.claim: Row 1 'Delegation line (inner stages; guidance.inner_context ...)' is 'existing'; callback is 'line 5 on an inner stage'; callback within the first 8 lines and 1,500 chars with at most 4 lines before it, for every route.

So 'existing' is false for heads, and its bytes (inline INLINE_STAGE_CONTEXT 196 chars; ask-agent SERIAL_INNER_CONTEXT 1,548 chars in 23 lines) are in no head budget or 6.2 net. The invariant cannot hold where the prefix is printed: on ask-agent every inner packet file and each whole print starts with 23 prefix lines (ask-agent validate-existing prints whole at 15,938 at 83); even inline a whole print has its header at line 5 (two prefix lines and two blank lines), so with the two pointer lines the callback is line 8 with 7 lines before it, not line 5 with 4 before; on ask-agent the header is line 25 and the callback line 28.
problems.evidence: skills/shiploop/scripts/shiploop_navigator.py: render() adds guidance.inner_context for stage in INNER, packet_head() does not (read); python3 len() of shiploop_prompts.SERIAL_INNER_CONTEXT = 1,548 chars, 23 lines; INLINE_STAGE_CONTEXT = 196; my render at default TMPDIR (83): ask-agent 05-validate-existing = 15,938 (<= PRINT_LIMIT, so whole, prefix first); whole-print 03-test-spec on main: inline header line 5 / callback line 6, ask-agent header line 25 / callback line 26 (SP/eff2/rt_top.py).
problems.correction: Say the head gets the prefix only if U7 adds it, and budget +196 (inline) / +1,548 (ask-agent) per inner head; define the position invariants from the header line (the status hook already strips the PREFIX) or exempt the prefix: 'callback within 3 lines of the header', not 'within the first 8 lines and 4 lines before it'.
